note: SSOT for the issue label vocabulary. Every label is group:value — values are single lowercase words, never hyphenated. The standards script creates missing labels and corrects description/color drift; it never deletes labels it does not know. A group's color is the default for its values; a value may override it. An exclusive group allows at most one of its labels per open issue; a required group demands exactly one.

status.summary: Where the issue sits in the lifecycle. Exactly one status: label per open issue.

inbox.description: Captured, not yet routed — triage drains this state. Exactly one status: label per open issue.

spec.description: Needs the detailed plan before build. Exactly one status: label per open issue.

queued.description: Plan ready, buildable now. Exactly one status: label per open issue. Pull one by self-assigning.

blocked.description: Waiting on a human decision. Exactly one status: label per open issue. A comment names the question.

parked.description: Kept on purpose, not now. Exactly one status: label per open issue.

type.summary: What kind of thing the issue is. Exactly one type: label per open issue. Set at capture by the issue template, rarely changes.

bug.description: Something is broken. Exactly one type: label per open issue. Set at capture.

enhancement.description: New or improved behavior. Exactly one type: label per open issue. Set at capture.

idea.description: Unshaped thought worth keeping. Exactly one type: label per open issue. Set at capture.

priority.summary: Order within the queue. Absence of a priority: label means normal — there is no priority:normal label.

high.description: Work this before unlabeled issues. Absence of a priority: label means normal.

low.description: Work this after unlabeled issues. Absence of a priority: label means normal.

agent.summary: Automation permission. Absence means humans only.

ok.description: An agent may work this issue autonomously. Absence means humans only.
